CARBON-22019-F2P-COLLAPSED-SEARCH-ICON-T.purpose: Render a real collapsed ExpandableSearch and verify its Search trigger uses the standard icon-tooltip visual contract, retains the Search tooltip label, starts hidden, and opens on hover.

CARBON-22019-P2P-DEFAULT-VALUE.purpose: Preserve rendering of a supplied default search value.

CARBON-22019-P2P-EXPAND-CLICK.purpose: Preserve mouse activation of the collapsed Search control.

CARBON-22019-P2P-FORWARDED-REF.purpose: Preserve forwarding of the underlying input reference.

CARBON-22019-P2P-BLUR-EMPTY.purpose: Preserve automatic collapse when an empty search loses focus.

CARBON-22019-P2P-BLUR-WITH-VALUE.purpose: Preserve the expanded state when a non-empty search loses focus.

CARBON-22019-P2P-BLUR-DEFAULT-EMPTY.purpose: Preserve blur handling for an empty-string default value.

CARBON-22019-P2P-BLUR-DEFAULT-ZERO.purpose: Preserve blur handling for numeric zero as meaningful content.

CARBON-22019-P2P-BLUR-DEFAULT-TEXT.purpose: Preserve blur handling for a non-empty default value.

CARBON-22019-P2P-BLUR-DEFAULT-UNDEFINED.purpose: Preserve blur handling when no default value is supplied.

CARBON-22019-P2P-ESCAPE-CLEAR-CLOSE.purpose: Preserve the two-step Escape behavior that clears content and then closes the search.
